mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DAILYLOOKS (dailylook_id, user_id, wear_date, description, file_id, canvas_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{dailylookId}, #{userId}, #{wearDate}, #{description}, #{fileId}, #{canvasJson}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO DAILYLOOK_ITEMS ( DAILYLOOK_ID, CLOTHES_ID, USER_ID, WEAR_DATE, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{dailylookId}, #{clothesId}, #{userId}, TO_DATE(#{wearDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT dailylook_id AS dailylookId, user_id AS userId, wear_date AS wearDate, description AS description, file_id AS fileId, canvas_json AS canvasJson FROM DAILYLOOKS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND wear_date = TO_DATE(#{wearDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
mapper.update: UPDATE DAILYLOOKS SET description = #{description}, file_id = #{fildId}, canvas_json = #{canvasJson}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE dailylook_id = #{dailylookId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(dailylook_id, 8))), 0) + 1 FROM dailylooks WHERE SUBSTR(dailylook_id, 2, 6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMMDD')
